questions.question: ___ United States is located in North America.
questions.explanation: The United States takes 'the' because its name contains a plural descriptive expression.

questions.question: The Nile is one of ___ longest rivers in the world.
Which sentence is correct?
options: The Japan is famous for technology.
A Japan is famous for technology.
An Japan is famous for technology.
questions.explanation: Most singular country names, including Japan, do not take an article.

questions.question: The ship sailed across ___ Mediterranean Sea.
Which country name requires 'the'?
questions.explanation: The conventional country name is 'the Netherlands'.

questions.question: The Amazon flows through ___ South America.
questions.explanation: Names of continents generally do not take an article.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The Mount Elbrus is in Russia.
A Mount Elbrus is in Russia.
An Mount Elbrus is in Russia.
questions.explanation: Individual mountain peaks generally do not take 'the'.

questions.question: The fishermen work near ___ Arabian Sea.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: The United Kingdom consists of four countries.
United Kingdom consists of four countries.
A United Kingdom consists of four countries.
An United Kingdom consists of four countries.
questions.correctAnswer: The United Kingdom consists of four countries.

questions.question: The boat travelled along ___ Danube.
questions.explanation: The names of rivers generally take 'the'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the article correctly?
options: The Philippines is an island country.
A Philippines is an island country.
An Philippines is an island country.
questions.correctAnswer: The Philippines is an island country.
questions.explanation: The Philippines is a country name that conventionally takes 'the'.
